setting: covered craft market in the old town center after the museum visit; cool-weather outing clothes

sentences.english: After leaving the museum, we stopped at a small craft market in the center of town.
sentences.japanese: 博物館を出たあと、町の真ん中にある小さな工芸品の市場に立ち寄りました。

sentences.english: That street is known to all the local people.
sentences.japanese: その通りは、地元の人ならみんな知っている場所です。

sentences.english: At the entrance, there was a large picture.
sentences.japanese: 入り口には大きな絵がありました。

sentences.english: “Was this picture painted by your father?” Tom asked.
sentences.japanese: 「この絵はお父さんが描いたんですか？」とトムが聞きました。

sentences.english: “No, it was not painted by my father.
sentences.japanese: 「いいえ、父が描いたのではありません。

sentences.english: It was painted by his friend,” the owner answered.
sentences.japanese: 父の友人が描いたんです」とお店の人は答えました。

sentences.english: Inside, there were many simple tables.
sentences.japanese: 店の中には、素朴なテーブルがたくさん並んでいました。

sentences.english: “What are they made of?” asked my sister.
sentences.japanese: 「何でできているんですか？」と妹が聞きました。

sentences.english: “They are made of wood from the local mountain,” the owner said with a smile.
sentences.japanese: 「地元の山の木で作られているんですよ」とお店の人は笑って答えました。

sentences.english: At another table, there was fresh bread made from flour, and colorful jam made from fruit.
sentences.japanese: 別のテーブルには、小麦粉で作られた焼きたてのパンと、果物で作られた色とりどりのジャムが並んでいました。

sentences.english: Tom is very interested in the history of this town.
sentences.japanese: トムはこの町の歴史にすごく興味を持っています。

sentences.english: I was surprised at how much he knows.
sentences.japanese: 彼がどれだけ知っているのか、わたしはびっくりしました。

sentences.english: When we left the market and looked up, the top of the far mountain was covered with bright white snow.
sentences.japanese: 市場を出て顔を上げると、遠くの山の頂上は真っ白な雪で覆われていました。
